title: Navajo skinwalker lore matches ranch activity
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Navajo skinwalker lore matches ranch activity, about traditional at Navajo lands / Skinwalker Ranch, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Cuz I was doing a little Googling and it was like talking about luminous objects,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the Navajo tradition of the skinwalker, a shapeshifting figure in the stories of the Navajo people, and Skinwalker Ranch, a property in the American West known for reports of strange events. Michels says that while searching online he found that the old lore talks about luminous, glowing objects, which he links to what is reported at the ranch. If the link holds, it would suggest the strange activity there is much older than modern reports.
